gotchas: The /cart/<variantId>:1 permalink 302s straight into /checkouts/cn/<token> with skip_shop_pay=true — there is no cart page hop and no Shop Pay diversion; guest card checkout is the default.
2026-10-17: confirmed; the Credit card radio is preselected, with Shop / PayPal / Google Pay express buttons above the form.

Checkout renders a duplicate hidden autofill form whose inputs carry the same name attributes (autofill_firstName, autofill_city, ...). Plain input[name=firstName] matches two elements; scope every contact/billing selector with :not([id^=autofill]).
Visible billing field ids are randomised per render (TextFieldP0-734 etc.) except #billing-address1 and #email — select by name, not id.
The CVV iframe is named card-fields-verification_value-<rand>, not card-fields-verification-<rand>.
Digital products (e.g. the $1 ringtone) skip the shipping step entirely, so checkout is a single page: contact, billing, card.
Custom domain store: detection must key on cdn.shopify.com script/link references and meta[name=shopify-checkout-api-token], not on a *.myshopify.com host.

2026-10-17: input[name=phone]:not([id^=autofill]) matches two inputs: the billing phone (required, placeholder 'Phone') and the optional Shop Pay 'Remember me' mobile phone (autocomplete=tel), which creates a Shop account when filled. The billing phone alone is input[name=phone][required]:not([id^=autofill]).
2026-10-17: picking a billing country without states (e.g. France) removes select[name=zone] from the form.
2026-10-17: each card iframe holds one input: number input[name=number], expiry input[name=expiry] (MM / YY), security code input[name=verification_value], name on card input[name=name].

2026-10-17: clicking #checkout-pay-button with every field filled raises a visible hCaptcha (iframe[src*=hcaptcha.com]) before any payment response; no decline and no confirmation appear behind it. Seen on two consecutive runs (2026-10-16 after a Shop Pay one-time-code dialog, 2026-10-17 without one).

route.note: The variant id is the variants[0].id field of /products/horse-theme-song-ringtone.js; the /cart/<variantId>:1 permalink redirects straight to the single-page checkout (contact, card, billing).
